name: School Savant
summary: Some arcanists specialize in a school of magic and trade flexibility for focus.

features.name: School Focus Rules (Su)
features.summary: Choose a Wizard arcane school or subschool and gain its powers using Arcanist level as Wizard level. Prepare one additional matching school spell of every available spell level, and choose two opposition schools whose spells use two preparation slots. Opposition-school magic-item crafting checks take a -4 penalty, and School Understanding is unavailable.
